Method of Attack: Contains a hex-encoded payload that, when unpacked, surveys and exfiltrates system information such as hostname, username, DNS servers, network interfaces, and files from specified directories.
Impacted Systems: Systems with the user 'daasadmin' or specific hostnames (DESKTOP-4E1IS0K, box, lili-pc, aws-7grara913oid5jsexgkq, instance) excluded from exfiltration
Attack Vector: Typosquatting and high version numbers to trick users into installing the package
Payload is double hex-encoded in some cases, making it harder to detect
Indicators of Compromise: Network requests to an unknown server with exfiltrated data
High major version numbers (90s and above)
Use of specific hostnames or usernames for exclusion logic
